cell_line: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS (Sigma, F0392) and stable isotope labeled lysine and arginine (light: 12 C and 14 N; heavy: 13 C and 15 N; 50 mg each for 500 mL medium).

Both HEK293T (ATCC), and HT1080 (ATCC) were cultured in Dulbecco’s modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM, Life Technologies) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, 2 mM L-glutamine and penicillin–streptomycin (Life Technologies).
